description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Inspector" name="Inspector">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterMachineDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RequiredWorkSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InputValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PressButtons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RequiredWorkJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InputAdditionalValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Inspection application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectAndShowValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inspection" name="Inspection begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_EnterDetails</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineDetails" name="Enter machine type and serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_EnterDetails</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterDetails_RequiredWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequiredWorkSplit" name="Perform required inspection work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterDetails_RequiredWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequiredWork_Questions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequiredWork_Buttons</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AskQuestions" name="Ask inspection questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequiredWork_Questions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Questions_InputValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InputValues" name="Input values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Questions_InputValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InputValues_RequiredWorkJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButtons" name="Press buttons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequiredWork_Buttons</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressButtons_CollectValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectAndShowValues" name="Automatically collect and show machine values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressButtons_CollectValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectValues_RequiredWorkJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequiredWorkJoin" name="Required inspection work complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InputValues_RequiredWorkJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectValues_RequiredWorkJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequiredWork_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" name="Are additional questions needed?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequiredWork_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions" name="Ask additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestions_InputValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InputAdditionalValues" name="Input additional values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestions_InputValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InputValues_AdditionalQuestionsJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" name="Continue after applicable questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InputValues_AdditionalQuestionsJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsJoin_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Inspection" name="Inspection complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestionsJoin_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_EnterDetails" sourceRef="Start_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterDetails_RequiredWork" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails" targetRef="Gateway_RequiredWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequiredWork_Questions" sourceRef="Gateway_RequiredWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_AskQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Questions_InputValues" sourceRef="Task_AskQuestions" targetRef="Task_InputValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InputValues_RequiredWorkJoin" sourceRef="Task_InputValues" targetRef="Gateway_RequiredWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequiredWork_Buttons" sourceRef="Gateway_RequiredWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_PressButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButtons_CollectValues" sourceRef="Task_PressButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectAndShowValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectValues_RequiredWorkJoin" sourceRef="Task_CollectAndShowValues" targetRef="Gateway_RequiredWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequiredWork_AdditionalQuestions" sourceRef="Gateway_RequiredWorkJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">resultsRequireAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestions_InputValues" sourceRef="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_InputAdditionalValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InputValues_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" sourceRef="Task_InputAdditionalValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsJoin_End" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestionsJoin" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
